verses.text: After plenty days, di word of di Lord come to Elijah for di third year, say, “Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I go send rain on di earth.”
Elijah go show imself to Ahab. Hunger hard well well for Samaria.
Ahab call Obadiah, wey dey over di house. Obadiah fear di Lord well well,
because e happen say as Jezebel dey cut off di prophets of di Lord, Obadiah take 100 prophets and hide dem, 50 for one cave, and e dey feed dem with bread and water.
Ahab talk to Obadiah say, “Go through di land, to all di springs of water and to all di streams. Maybe we go find grass to save di horses and mules alive, so that we no go lose all di animals.”
So dem divide di land between dem to pass through am. Ahab go one way by imself, and Obadiah go another way by imself.
As Obadiah dey for road, look, Elijah meet am. E know am, fall with im face down and talk say, “Na you be dis, my oga Elijah?”
E answer am say, “Na me. Go tell your oga say, ‘Look, Elijah dey here.’”
E talk say, “Wetin be my sin, say you wan give your servant to Ahab hand to kill me?
As di Lord your God dey alive, no nation or kingdom dey wia my oga no send people go look for you. And as dem talk say, ‘E no dey here,’ e make di kingdom and nation swear say dem no find you.
Now you dey talk say, ‘Go tell your oga, “Look, Elijah dey here.”’
E go happen say as I leave you, di Spirit of di Lord go carry you go place wey I no know. So as I go tell Ahab and e no find you, e go kill me. But I, your servant, don fear di Lord from my youth.
Dem no tell my oga wetin I do as Jezebel kill di prophets of di Lord, how I hide 100 men of di Lord prophets, 50 for one cave, and feed dem with bread and water?
Now you dey talk say, ‘Go tell your oga, “Look, Elijah dey here,”’ and e go kill me.”
Elijah talk say, “As di Lord of Armies dey alive, wey I dey stand before, I go show myself to am today for sure.”
So Obadiah go meet Ahab and tell am, and Ahab go meet Elijah.
As Ahab see Elijah, Ahab talk to am say, “Na you be dat, you wey dey bring trouble to Israel?”
E answer say, “I no bring trouble to Israel, but you and your papa house, because una don leave di commands of di Lord and una don follow di Baals.
So now send, and gather all Israel to me for Mount Carmel, and di 450 prophets of Baal, and di 400 prophets of Asherah, wey dey eat for Jezebel table.”
So Ahab send to all Israel pikin dem and gather di prophets together for Mount Carmel.
Elijah come near to all di people and talk say, “Until when una go dey shake between two minds? If di Lord na God, follow am, but if na Baal, den follow am.” Di people no answer am even one word.
Den Elijah talk to di people say, “I, na only me remain as di Lord prophet, but Baal prophets na 450 men.

So make dem give us two bulls. Make dem choose one bull for demselves, cut am into pieces and put am on di wood, but no put fire under am. I go prepare di other bull and put am on di wood, and I no go put fire under am.
Una call di name of una god, and I go call di name of di Lord. Di God wey answer with fire, na im be God.” All di people answer say, “Di word good.”
Elijah talk to di prophets of Baal say, “Choose one bull for una self and prepare am first, because una plenty. Call di name of una god, but no put fire under am.”

Dem take di bull wey dem give dem and prepare am, and dem call di name of Baal from morning reach noon, say, “Baal, hear us!” But voice no dey, and nobody answer. Dem jump round di altar wey dem make.
E happen for noon say Elijah dey laugh dem and talk say, “Shout loud, because na god e be! Maybe e dey think, or e don go aside, or e dey travel, or maybe e dey sleep and dem must wake am.”
Dem shout loud and cut demselves as dem dey do am with knives and spears until blood pour on dem.
E happen say as midday pass, dem dey prophesy until di time of di evening sacrifice, but voice no dey, nobody answer, and nobody pay attention.
Elijah talk to all di people say, “Come near me.” All di people come near am. E repair di altar of di Lord wey dem don throw down.
Elijah take 12 stones, as di number of di tribes of Jacob pikin dem, wey di word of di Lord come to say, “Israel go be your name.”
With di stones e build altar for di name of di Lord, and e dig one trench round di altar, big enough to hold two measures of seed.
E arrange di wood, cut di bull into pieces and put am on di wood. E talk say, “Fill four jars with water and pour am on di burnt sacrifice and on di wood.”
E talk say, “Do am di second time,” and dem do am di second time. E talk say, “Do am di third time,” and dem do am di third time.
Di water run round di altar, and e fill di trench with water too.

E happen for di time of di evening sacrifice say Elijah di prophet come near and talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Abraham, of Isaac and of Israel, make dem know today say you be God for Israel, and say I be your servant, and say I do all dis things by your word.
Hear me, di Lord, hear me, so that dis people go know say you, di Lord, na God, and say you don turn dem heart back again.”
Den di fire of di Lord fall and burn di burnt sacrifice, and di wood, and di stones, and di dust, and lick up di water wey dey di trench.
As all di people see am, dem fall with dem face down, and dem talk say, “Di Lord, na im be God! Di Lord, na im be God!”
Elijah talk to dem say, “Catch di prophets of Baal! Make nobody among dem escape!” Dem catch dem, and Elijah bring dem go down to Kishon stream and kill dem there.
Elijah talk to Ahab say, “Stand up, eat and drink, because sound of plenty rain dey.”
So Ahab go up to eat and drink. Elijah go up to di top of Carmel, bow down to di ground and put im face between im knees.
E talk to im servant say, “Go up now, look toward di sea.” E go up, look, and talk say, “Nothing dey.” Elijah talk say, “Go again seven times.”

E happen for di seventh time say e talk say, “Look, one small cloud, like man hand, dey rise from di sea.” Elijah talk say, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down, so that rain no go stop you.’”
E happen after small time say di sky turn black with clouds and wind, and big rain fall. Ahab ride go Jezreel.
Di hand of di Lord dey on Elijah, and e tie im cloth round im waist and run before Ahab reach di entrance of Jezreel.
Ahab tell Jezebel all wey Elijah do, and how e kill all di prophets with sword.
Den Jezebel send messenger to Elijah say, “Make di gods do me so, and more, if I no make your life be like di life of one of dem by dis time tomorrow.”
As e see am, e stand up and run for im life, and reach Beersheba, wey belong to Judah, and leave im servant there.

But e imself go one day journey inside di wilderness, come sit down under one juniper tree, and e ask say make e die. E talk say, “E don do. Now, di Lord, take my life, because I no better pass my papa dem.”
E lie down and sleep under di juniper tree, and look, one angel touch am and talk to am say, “Stand up and eat.”
E look, and look, bread wey dem bake for coals and one jar of water dey for im head. E eat and drink, and lie down again.
Di angel of di Lord come again di second time, touch am and talk say, “Stand up and eat, because di journey too long for you.”
E stand up, eat and drink, and e waka with di strength of dat food 40 days and 40 nights reach Horeb, di mountain of God.
E reach one cave there and sleep there, and look, di word of di Lord come to am, and e talk to am say, “Wetin you dey do here, Elijah?”

E talk say, “I don dey very jealous for di Lord, di God of Armies, because Israel pikin dem don leave your covenant, throw down your altars and kill your prophets with sword. I, na only me remain, and dem dey look for my life to take am away.”

E talk say, “Go out and stand for di mountain before di Lord.” Look, di Lord pass, and big strong wind tear di mountains and break di rocks to pieces before di Lord, but di Lord no dey inside di wind. After di wind, earthquake come, but di Lord no dey inside di earthquake.
After di earthquake, fire come, but di Lord no dey inside di fire. After di fire, one small quiet voice come.
E happen say as Elijah hear am, e cover im face with im cloak, go out and stand for di entrance of di cave. Look, one voice come to am and talk say, “Wetin you dey do here, Elijah?”

E talk say, “I don dey very jealous for di Lord, di God of Armies, because Israel pikin dem don leave your covenant, throw down your altars and kill your prophets with sword. I, na only me remain, and dem dey look for my life to take am away.”
Di Lord talk to am say, “Go, return di way wey you take come go di wilderness of Damascus. As you reach there, you go anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
And Jehu, Nimshi pikin, you go anoint to be king over Israel. And Elisha, Shaphat pikin, from Abel Meholah, you go anoint to be prophet for your place.
E go happen say di one wey escape from Hazael sword, Jehu go kill am, and di one wey escape from Jehu sword, Elisha go kill am.
Still, I don keep 7,000 for Israel, all di knees wey no bow to Baal, and every mouth wey no kiss am.”
So e leave there and find Elisha, Shaphat pikin, wey dey plow with 12 pairs of oxen before am, and e dey with di 12th. Elijah pass go meet am and throw im cloak on am.
E leave di oxen and run follow Elijah and talk say, “Make I kiss my papa and my mama, and den I go follow you.” E talk to am say, “Go back, because wetin I do you?”
E return from following am, take one pair of oxen and kill dem, and boil dem meat with di wood of di oxen things, and give di people, and dem eat. Den e stand up, follow Elijah and dey serve am.
Ben Hadad di king of Syria gather all im army together, and 32 kings dey with am, with horses and chariots. E go up, surround Samaria and fight against am.
E send messengers to Ahab king of Israel inside di city,
and talk to am say, “Dis na wetin Ben Hadad talk: ‘Your silver and your gold na mine. Your wives and your pikin dem too, even di best ones, na mine.’”
Di king of Israel answer say, “E be as you talk, my oga di king. I be your own, and all wey I get.”
Di messengers come again and talk say, “Dis na wetin Ben Hadad talk: ‘I send to you say, “You go give me your silver, and your gold, and your wives, and your pikin dem,”
but I go send my servants to you by dis time tomorrow, and dem go search your house and di houses of your servants. And everything wey sweet your eyes, dem go take am for dem hand carry go.’”

Den di king of Israel call all di elders of di land and talk say, “Make una look how dis man dey look for trouble, because e send to me for my wives, and for my pikin dem, and for my silver, and for my gold, and I no refuse am.”
All di elders and all di people talk to am say, “No listen, and no agree.”

So e talk to di messengers of Ben Hadad say, “Tell my oga di king, ‘All wey you send for from your servant for di first time, I go do am, but dis thing I no fit do.’” Di messengers go and bring word back to am.
Ben Hadad send to am say, “Make di gods do me so, and more, if di dust of Samaria go reach to fill hand of all di people wey follow me.”
Di king of Israel answer say, “Tell am, ‘Make di one wey dey wear im weapon no boast like di one wey dey comot am.’”
E happen say as Ben Hadad hear dis message, as e dey drink with di kings for di tents, e talk to im servants say, “Get ready.” Dem get ready against di city.
Look, one prophet come near Ahab king of Israel and talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘You don see all dis big crowd? Look, I go give am into your hand today, and you go know say I be di Lord.’”
Ahab talk say, “By who?” E talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘By di young men of di leaders of di provinces.’” Den e talk say, “Who go begin di battle?” E answer say, “You.”
Den e count di young men of di leaders of di provinces, and dem na 232. After dem, e count all di people, all Israel pikin dem, wey na 7,000.
Dem go out for noon. But Ben Hadad dey drink till e drunk for di tents, e and di kings, di 32 kings wey dey help am.
Di young men of di leaders of di provinces go out first. Ben Hadad send people go see, and dem tell am say, “Men don come out from Samaria.”
E talk say, “Whether dem come out for peace, catch dem alive, or whether dem come out for war, catch dem alive.”
So dis ones go out of di city, di young men of di leaders of di provinces, and di army wey follow dem.
Each one kill im man. Di Syrians run, and Israel chase dem, and Ben Hadad di king of Syria escape on horse with horsemen.
Di king of Israel go out and strike di horses and chariots, and e kill di Syrians with big slaughter.
Di prophet come near di king of Israel and talk to am say, “Go, make yourself strong, and take note and see wetin you go do, because for di turn of di year di king of Syria go come up against you.”
Di servants of di king of Syria talk to am say, “Dem gods na gods of di hills, so dem strong pass us. But make we fight dem for di plain, and we go strong pass dem for sure.
Do dis thing: take di kings away, every man from im place, and put captains for dem place,

and count army for yourself like di army wey you don lose, horse for horse and chariot for chariot, and we go fight dem for di plain, and we go strong pass dem for sure.” E listen to dem voice and do so.
E happen for di turn of di year say Ben Hadad gather di Syrians and go up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
Dem gather Israel pikin dem and give dem food, and dem go against dem. Israel pikin dem camp before dem like two small flocks of goats, but di Syrians fill di country.

One man of God come near and talk to di king of Israel say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Because di Syrians don talk say, “Di Lord na god of di hills, but e no be god of di valleys,” so I go give all dis big crowd into your hand, and you go know say I be di Lord.’”
Dem camp one before di other seven days. Den for di seventh day di battle begin, and Israel pikin dem kill 100,000 Syrian foot soldiers for one day.
But di rest run go Aphek, enter di city, and di wall fall on 27,000 men wey remain. Ben Hadad run and enter di city, enter one inside room.

Im servants talk to am say, “Look now, we don hear say di kings of Israel house na kings wey get mercy. Make we put sackcloth on our waist and ropes on our head and go out to di king of Israel. Maybe e go save your life.”

So dem put sackcloth on dem waist and ropes on dem head and come to di king of Israel and talk say, “Your servant Ben Hadad talk say, ‘Make I live.’” E talk say, “E still dey alive? Na my brother e be.”

Di men dey watch well well, and dem hurry catch wetin dey im mind, and dem talk say, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Den e talk say, “Go, bring am.” Den Ben Hadad come out to am, and e make am enter di chariot.

Ben Hadad talk to am say, “Di cities wey my papa take from your papa I go return dem, and you go make streets for yourself for Damascus, as my papa make for Samaria.” Ahab talk say, “I go let you go with dis covenant.” So e make covenant with am and let am go.
One man among di prophets pikin dem talk to im friend by di word of di Lord say, “Strike me.” Di man refuse to strike am.
Den e talk to am say, “Because you no obey di voice of di Lord, look, as you leave me, lion go kill you.” So as e leave am, one lion find am and kill am.
Den e find another man and talk say, “Strike me.” Di man strike am, and as e strike am, e wound am.
So di prophet go, wait for di king for road, and e cover im eyes with cloth to change how e look.

As di king dey pass, e cry out to di king and talk say, “Your servant go inside di battle, and look, one man turn aside and bring one man come meet me and talk say, ‘Guard dis man. If e miss anyhow, den your life go be for im life, or you go pay one talent of silver.’
As your servant dey busy here and there, e don disappear.” Di king of Israel talk to am say, “Na so your judgment go be. You yourself don decide am.”
E hurry remove di cloth from im eyes, and di king of Israel know am say na one of di prophets e be.
E talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Because you don let go di man wey I don mark for destruction, so your life go go for im life, and your people for im people.’”
Di king of Israel go im house sad and vex, and e reach Samaria.
E happen after dis things say Naboth from Jezreel get one vineyard wey dey Jezreel, near di palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

Ahab talk to Naboth say, “Give me your vineyard, so that I go use am as garden for vegetables, because e near, beside my house. I go give you better vineyard pass am for am, or if e good for you, I go give you di price of am for money.”
Naboth talk to Ahab say, “Make di Lord no let me give my papa dem inheritance to you.”

Ahab enter im house sad and vex because of di word wey Naboth from Jezreel talk to am, because e talk say, “I no go give you my papa dem inheritance.” E lie down for im bed, turn im face away and no eat bread.
But Jezebel im wife come meet am and talk to am say, “Why your spirit sad so, say you no dey eat bread?”

E talk to am say, “Because I talk to Naboth from Jezreel and talk to am say, ‘Give me your vineyard for money, or if e good for you, I go give you another vineyard for am,’ and e answer say, ‘I no go give you my vineyard.’”
Jezebel im wife talk to am say, “You dey rule Israel kingdom now? Stand up, eat bread and make your heart happy. I go give you di vineyard of Naboth from Jezreel.”
So e write letters for Ahab name and seal dem with im seal and send di letters to di elders and to di leaders wey dey im city, wey dey stay with Naboth.
E write for di letters say, “Announce fasting, and put Naboth for high place among di people,
and put two men, wicked men, before am, make dem give witness against am say, ‘You curse God and di king.’ Den carry am out and stone am to death.”
Di men of im city, di elders and di leaders wey dey stay for im city, do as Jezebel send to dem, as dem write am for di letters wey e send to dem.
Dem announce fasting and put Naboth for high place among di people.

Di two men, di wicked men, come enter and sit before am, and di wicked men give witness against am, against Naboth, before di people say, “Naboth curse God and di king.” Den dem carry am out of di city and stone am to death with stones.
Den dem send to Jezebel say, “Dem don stone Naboth, and e don die.”

E happen say as Jezebel hear say dem don stone Naboth and e don die, Jezebel talk to Ahab say, “Stand up, take di vineyard of Naboth from Jezreel, wey e refuse to give you for money, because Naboth no dey alive again, e don die.”
E happen say as Ahab hear say Naboth don die, Ahab stand up to go down to di vineyard of Naboth from Jezreel to take am.
Di word of di Lord come to Elijah from Tishbe say,
“Stand up, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, wey dey stay for Samaria. Look, e dey di vineyard of Naboth, wia e go down to take am.

You go talk to am say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “You don kill, and you don take am too?”’ You go talk to am say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “For di place wia dogs lick Naboth blood, dogs go lick your own blood, even yours.”’”
Ahab talk to Elijah say, “You don find me, my enemy?” E answer say, “I don find you, because you don sell yourself to do wetin bad for di Lord eyes.
Look, I go bring evil on you, and I go sweep you away completely, and I go cut off from Ahab every male, di one wey dem lock up and di one wey dey free for Israel,
and I go make your house like Jeroboam house, Nebat pikin, and like Baasha house, Ahijah pikin, because of how you make me vex and make Israel sin.
About Jezebel too, di Lord talk say, ‘Dogs go eat Jezebel by di wall of Jezreel.’
Anybody for Ahab family wey die for di city, dogs go eat am, and anybody wey die for di field, birds of di sky go eat am.”
Nobody like Ahab dey, wey sell imself to do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, wey Jezebel im wife push.
E do very wicked thing as e follow idols, as all di Amorites do, wey di Lord drive out before Israel pikin dem.
E happen say as Ahab hear dis words, e tear im clothes, put sackcloth on im body, fast, lie down for sackcloth and dey waka slowly.
Di word of di Lord come to Elijah from Tishbe say,
“You see how Ahab don humble imself before me? Because e don humble imself before me, I no go bring di evil for im days, but for im pikin days I go bring di evil on im house.”
Dem stay three years without war between Syria and Israel.
E happen for di third year say Jehoshaphat di king of Judah go down to di king of Israel.
Di king of Israel talk to im servants say, “Una know say Ramoth Gilead na our own, and we still dey quiet and no take am from di king of Syria hand?”
E talk to Jehoshaphat say, “You go go with me to battle go Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat talk to di king of Israel say, “I be like you, my people like your people, my horses like your horses.”
Jehoshaphat talk to di king of Israel say, “Make you first ask for di word of di Lord.”

Den di king of Israel gather di prophets together, about 400 men, and talk to dem say, “Make I go against Ramoth Gilead for battle, or make I hold back?” Dem talk say, “Go up, because Lord go give am into di king hand.”
But Jehoshaphat talk say, “Prophet of di Lord no dey here again, so that we go ask am?”

Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “One man still dey wey we fit use ask di Lord, Micaiah, Imlah pikin, but I hate am, because e no dey prophesy good about me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat talk say, “Make di king no talk so.”
Den di king of Israel call one officer and talk say, “Bring Micaiah, Imlah pikin, quick quick.”

Di king of Israel and Jehoshaphat di king of Judah dey sit, each one for im throne, wear dem royal clothes, for open place for di entrance of di gate of Samaria, and all di prophets dey prophesy before dem.
Zedekiah, Chenaanah pikin, make iron horns for imself and talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘With dis ones you go push di Syrians until dem finish.’”
All di prophets prophesy so say, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, because di Lord go give am into di king hand.”
Di messenger wey go call Micaiah talk to am say, “Look, di words of di prophets dey talk good for di king with one mouth. Make your word be like di word of one of dem, and talk wetin good.”
Micaiah talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, wetin di Lord talk to me, na dat I go talk.”
As e reach di king, di king talk to am say, “Micaiah, make we go Ramoth Gilead for battle, or make we hold back?” E answer am say, “Go up and prosper, and di Lord go give am into di king hand.”
Di king talk to am say, “How many times I go make you swear say you go talk only truth to me for di name of di Lord?”
E talk say, “I see all Israel scatter for di mountains, like sheep wey no get shepherd. Di Lord talk say, ‘Dis people no get oga. Make each one return to im house in peace.’”
Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “I no tell you say e no go prophesy good about me, but evil?”
Micaiah talk say, “So hear di word of di Lord. I see di Lord dey sit for im throne, and all di army of heaven dey stand by am for im right hand and for im left.
Di Lord talk say, ‘Who go deceive Ahab, so that e go go up and fall for Ramoth Gilead?’ One talk one thing, another talk another thing.
One spirit come out, stand before di Lord and talk say, ‘I go deceive am.’
Di Lord talk to am say, ‘How?’ E talk say, ‘I go go out and be lying spirit for di mouth of all im prophets.’ E talk say, ‘You go deceive am, and you go win too. Go out and do so.’
So now, look, di Lord don put lying spirit for di mouth of all dis your prophets, and di Lord don talk evil about you.”
Den Zedekiah, Chenaanah pikin, come near and slap Micaiah for face and talk say, “Which way di Spirit of di Lord pass from me to talk to you?”
Micaiah talk say, “Look, you go see for dat day, as you go enter inside room to hide yourself.”
Di king of Israel talk say, “Take Micaiah and carry am go back to Amon di governor of di city and to Joash di king pikin,
and talk say, ‘Dis na wetin di king talk: “Put dis man for prison and feed am with di bread of suffering and di water of suffering until I return in peace.”’”
Micaiah talk say, “If you return in peace at all, di Lord no talk by me.” E talk say, “Hear, una peoples, all of una.”
So di king of Israel and Jehoshaphat di king of Judah go up to Ramoth Gilead.
Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “I go change how I look and enter di battle, but you wear your royal clothes.” Di king of Israel change how e look and enter di battle.
Di king of Syria don command di 32 captains of im chariots say, “No fight with small or big, except only with di king of Israel.”
E happen say as di captains of di chariots see Jehoshaphat, dem talk say, “For sure na di king of Israel,” and dem turn aside to fight against am, and Jehoshaphat cry out.
E happen say as di captains of di chariots see say no be di king of Israel, dem turn back from chasing am.

One man draw im bow anyhow and strike di king of Israel between di joints of di armor. So e talk to di driver of im chariot say, “Turn round and carry me out of di battle, because dem don wound me bad.”
Di battle increase dat day, and dem prop up di king for im chariot against di Syrians, and e die for evening, and di blood run from di wound enter di bottom of di chariot.
One cry go through di army as di sun dey go down say, “Every man go im city, and every man go im country!”
So di king die and dem bring am go Samaria, and dem bury di king for Samaria.
Dem wash di chariot by di pool of Samaria, and dogs lick up im blood, and prostitutes dey wash demselves there, as di word of di Lord wey e talk.
Di rest of wetin Ahab do, and all wey e do, and di ivory house wey e build, and all di cities wey e build, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
So Ahab die join im papa dem, and im pikin Ahaziah rule for im place.
Jehoshaphat, Asa pikin, begin to rule over Judah for di fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Jehoshaphat be 35 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 25 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Azubah, Shilhi pikin.

E waka for all di way of im papa Asa. E no turn aside from am, e do wetin good for di Lord eyes. But dem no remove di high places, di people still dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places.
Jehoshaphat make peace with di king of Israel.
Di rest of wetin Jehoshaphat do, and im power wey e show, and how e fight, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Di rest of di men wey dey sell dem body for idol worship, wey remain for di days of im papa Asa, e remove dem from di land.
No king dey for Edom. One deputy na im be king.
Jehoshaphat make ships of Tarshish to go Ophir for gold, but dem no go, because di ships break for Ezion Geber.
Den Ahaziah, Ahab pikin, talk to Jehoshaphat say, “Make my servants go with your servants for di ships.” But Jehoshaphat no agree.
Jehoshaphat die join im papa dem and dem bury am with im papa dem for im papa David city, and im pikin Jehoram rule for im place.
Ahaziah, Ahab pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria for di 17th year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and e rule two years over Israel.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and e waka for im papa way, and for im mama way, and for Jeroboam way, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.
E serve Baal and worship am, and make di Lord, di God of Israel, vex, as all wey im papa do.
